II. 3. 38</ls>, मन्यकर्मण्यनादरे विभाषाऽप्राणिषु <ls n="P. II. 3.">17</ls>. .²2 Ease, facility (one of the senses of आदर being ‘effort or care’, see the word); ˚खण्डितशङ्करशरासनः <ls>U. 1</ls> (perhaps also ‘without any respect for the bow of the great god’); अनादरोपात्तघृतैकसायकम् <ls>Ki. 14. 36</ls>.
